query: Section 232 steel aluminum tariff exclusions expiration

statements.text: Pursuant to Presidential Proclamations 10895 and 10896 of February 10, 2025, Commerce is no longer processing Section 232 Exclusion Requests effective 11:59 PM ET on February 10, 2025, and is no longer accepting or issuing exclusions from the Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs.
Section 232 Exclusions already granted and activated as of February 10, 2025, will remain effective until their expiration date or until their excluded volume is exhausted, whichever occurs first.
In February, President Trump announced his intent to terminate the Section 232 exclusion process, which has since been allowed to expire.
